instruction: Fix `merge_sorted` in `seqops/merge.py` so it keeps the remaining elements of the right list once the left list is exhausted. It currently drops the right tail, so merging [1, 2] with [3, 4, 5] loses 3, 4 and 5.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/seqops/merge.py b/seqops/merge.py
--- a/seqops/merge.py
+++ b/seqops/merge.py
@@ -15,4 +15,5 @@
             result.append(right[j])
             j += 1
     result.extend(left[i:])
+    result.extend(right[j:])
     return result
